column1: # Generated by `lake exe oracle verdict` (spec/Oracle.lean) from the definition
# in spec/Aontu: the verdicts of vet, each case a schema and a document under
# the key v, run in the default mode, without the fill (noFill) and under
# --partial (partial), as `verdict` rows whose expectation is the one class
# `vet` gives, which `vet_iff` makes the definition's own: error where the
# schema does not stand, invalid where the meet is dead, valid where it
# singles out a value (and the data is an instance, without the fill), and
# Regenerate with `make spec`; never edit by hand. The cases the ports do
# not yet answer this way are listed in spec/ledger.tsv.
